data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. This behavior is related to the SSO token format change in v4.2. Please have your administrator re-save the SSO settings in the Admin Console to refresh internal certificates, and ensure your Okta 'Application Sign On URL' is formatted correctly. Finally, please have all users clear their browser cache and cookies. [T-4470] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
